name: egm
description: Elephant-Goldfish Model: spec-driven development with deep-context drafting and zero-context Goldfish reviews.

interface.longDescription: Draft software specifications, stress-test them with fresh-context Goldfish reviewers, resolve findings, and check implementation drift. EGM includes seven skills for developers working in a local codebase. It reads project files and writes design documents and review reports. Bootstrap can run local shell commands. Reviews require native subagents with fresh context; the workflow stops if the host cannot provide isolation. Model calls use your host account's quota. Cloud harness verification remains partial; see TESTING.md. This is not an officially supported Google product.
